name: The Earthen Ring

angles.text: As a Skyborne adventurer leaving Valanaar, you make the historic journey to Azeroth as part of its advance vanguard. You leave the cult troubles behind and set foot on Mulgore’s plains.

As a Tauren native to Mulgore, you witness travelers from Zephras descending upon your ancestral plains. Welcoming these visitors offers an early connection to allies seeking a foothold in your lands.

As a Shaman, you share the Windshapers’ reverence for the elements and their reliance on the winds to guide their crossing. Arriving under The Earthen Ring connects you to elemental traditions taking root in Mulgore.

faq.answer: The Windshapers send a vanguard ahead to establish a presence on Azeroth while their leaders remain in Valanaar. Cult activity there disrupted the original plans and delayed the rest of the group, so the advance party travels alone until reinforcements can follow.
faq.q: Why are the Windshapers traveling to Azeroth?

faq.answer: Alaana Stormwalker welcomes Windshapers arriving from Zephras in Mulgore. She says establishing a secure presence in these new lands will take time and advises newcomers to explore the surrounding region and prepare for Azeroth’s dangers.
Cult activity in Valanaar delayed the main departure. Expedition leaders stay behind at the lodge to settle the trouble, while a small vanguard boards a skycutter and travels ahead to Azeroth.
faq.q: Why was the main departure delayed?

aliases: how do you travel to azeroth
faq.answer: Travelers board a skycutter at the docks just outside the lodge in Valanaar. It carries the vanguard across the sky to Mulgore, connecting Zephras with Azeroth during the initial expedition.
faq.q: How do travelers journey from Valanaar to Mulgore?

faq.answer: Zephras is the home of the adventurers arriving aboard the skycutter. In Mulgore, Alaana Stormwalker welcomes newcomers from Zephras and says favorable winds guided their crossing into unfamiliar, dangerous Azeroth.

New arrivals are encouraged to scout the surrounding lands of Mulgore. Learning the nearby terrain, creatures, and local threats will help them as they establish a presence in this unfamiliar, hazardous world.
faq.q: What should adventurers do upon arriving in Mulgore?

sections.body:
Cult activity in Valanaar has disrupted the Windshapers’ plans to travel to Azeroth. Their senior leaders stay behind at the lodge to finish urgent business and quell the threat, while a small vanguard sets out ahead. At the docks just outside the lodge, the pioneers board a skycutter bound across the skies.

Their commanders promise to join them soon. Until then, the advance group must establish a presence before the rest can follow.
sections.title: Departure from Valanaar

sections.body:
In Mulgore, Alaana Stormwalker welcomes the arriving adventurers from Zephras. Establishing a foothold in Azeroth will take time, so newcomers are encouraged to scout the surrounding territory and grow accustomed to it.

The winds favor the expedition, but Azeroth is unfamiliar and perilous. Travelers should learn the local terrain, wildlife, and neighboring inhabitants before those still in Valanaar arrive to join them.
sections.title: Arrival in Mulgore

summary: From Zephras, the Windshapers of The Earthen Ring reach Azeroth as an advance vanguard. After cult activity delays the rest in Valanaar, they board a skycutter outside the lodge and make landfall in Mulgore to meet Alaana Stormwalker and adjust to a vast, dangerous world.
